basic_details.job_title: WAPCOS Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online for Expert, Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Experts with relevant experience can apply online until 31 March 2027 to join the WAPCOS Expert Databank. The specialisations cover water resources, power, infrastructure development, ports and harbours, and other fields. how_to_apply: Applications are made online on the WAPCOS portal at rep.wapcos.co.in until 31 March 2027. The notice describes these steps:

Open the "Empanelment/Data Bank of experts in various fields" page (EXPERT-DATABANK-2026) on rep.wapcos.co.in and select "Apply now", or select "Apply for this specialisation" next to a specialisation.
If you are new to the portal, create your account. If you are already registered, sign in with your mobile OTP.
Choose your sector and your specialisations. The application allows you to select more than one.
Complete your details in the online application.
Download the "Prescribed CV format" (Annexure-II) from the "Advertisement and CV format" box on the same page and fill it in.
Upload the filled CV with your online application.
Upload an updated CV in the prescribed "Detailed Curriculum Vitae" format (Annexure-II). The format asks for:
Name of Expert, and Specialisation/Applied For
Category (GEN/OBC/SC/ST)
Full address, including phone and e-mail
Date of birth and nationality
Education: college or university and other specialised education, with names of institutions, degrees obtained and dates of obtainment
Membership of professional associations
Other training: significant training since the degrees listed under Education
Countries of work experience
Languages, with your proficiency (Good, Fair or Poor) in speaking, reading and writing
Employment record: every job since graduation in reverse order, starting with your present position, with dates (from and to), employer and position held

Work undertaken that best illustrates your capability to handle the position: up to five assignments, each with the name of the assignment or project, year, location, client, main project features, positions held and activities performed
Certification, with your signature, the date (Date/Month/Year) and your full name
You may attach separate sheets if the space in the CV format is not enough.
important_instructions: By signing the CV certification, you certify that the CV correctly describes you, your qualifications and your experience. A wilful misstatement may lead to disqualification, or to dismissal if you have been engaged. The certification also records your agreement to work for WAPCOS and your consent to WAPCOS including your CV in bids it is submitting. The CV must name the specialisation you are applying for.

content_sections.heading: About WAPCOS
content_sections.text: WAPCOS Limited is a public sector enterprise of the Government of India. It keeps an Expert Databank through its portal rep.wapcos.co.in. Experts in the databank may be considered for WAPCOS's future requirements. When applicants sign the CV certification, they also consent to their CV being included in bids that WAPCOS is submitting.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Annexure-I, "Categories of Expert Required For Empanelment (Fixed/ Short Term Basis)", lists 56 specialisations. It does not give a number of vacancies for any of them. Each specialisation is counted as 1 here. Instrumentation Specialist appears in both the Water Resources Sector and the Power Sector, with the same qualification. It is counted once in each sector. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Annexure-I calls the requirement the "Desired Qualification". Each specialisation's qualification is given below exactly as printed. When two or more specialisations in the same sector have word-for-word the same qualification, they share one row. The ERP Expert row is the only one that states a minimum number of years of experience: 5 years in IT field. The other specialisations ask for "relevant experience", "Project experience" or experience in the area named in their row. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see Annexure-I of the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 has 56 vacancies, 1 for each specialisation, because the notice does not print a number. The 56 specialisations are 9 in the Water Resources Sector, 8 in the Power Sector, 14 in Infrastructure Development, 4 in Ports & Harbours and 21 in Others.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the WAPCOS Expert Databank?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 March 2027. Applications opened on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification depends on the specialisation. For example, Irrigation Expert needs B.E. (Civil)/M.E (Irrigation/Hydraulics) with relevant experience. Energy Auditor needs B.E. (Electrical Engineering) and Certified by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online on rep.wapcos.co.in by creating an account or signing in with your mobile OTP. Then select your sector and specialisations, complete your details and upload your CV in the prescribed format.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for more than one specialisation in the WAPCOS Expert Databank?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says you can select more than one specialisation in the application.

faq.question: Q6. How will WAPCOS select experts from the databank?
faq.answer: WAPCOS may consider suitable experts for future requirements and contact the experts it shortlists.

faq.question: Q7. Does applying to the WAPCOS Expert Databank guarantee a job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says that submitting an application does not confirm a job offer. The databank is for future WAPCOS requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Is the WAPCOS expert empanelment permanent?
faq.answer: No. Annexure-I lists the categories of expert for empanelment on a "Fixed/ Short Term Basis".

faq.question: Q9. Which CV format must be used for the WAPCOS Expert Databank?
faq.answer: Use the "Detailed Curriculum Vitae" format in Annexure-II, which can be downloaded from the "Advertisement and CV format" box on the application page. Fill it in and upload it with your online application.
